Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE native-resolution transparent PNG game animation frame, 1024x1024 or larger square, only one character, no grid. Create the celestial musician girl RUN frame E06, facing screen RIGHT in strict side profile. Reference 1 is her E01 character appearance, scale and camera only, NOT the limb pose. Reference 2 is her exact identity portrait. Reference 3 is the PRIMARY approved clean bright hand-painted Daoist chibi style only; copy no UI or other character.
Preserve exact long purple hair, lotus bun/gold pearl crown, purple eyes, forehead jewel, ivory-lavender-gold tunic/sleeves, purple short trousers, ivory-gold boots, jade waist knot and purple-gold crescent seven-string qin. Keep same rounded proportions, complete body/ribbons, consistent light. Transparent background with clean antialiasing and NO red/blue/magenta colored matte fringe.
CRITICAL POSE E06, flight after rear RIGHT toe-off: Both shoes AIRBORNE. The NEAR anatomical RIGHT thigh travels backward screen-left but its knee now bends so the RIGHT heel rises toward the buttock. The FAR anatomical LEFT thigh is raised forward screen-right; its knee starts to OPEN and left ankle moves forward beneath knee, toe lifted slightly. This is a compact flight transition, NOT E01's wide landing stance and NOT E04's grounded extended rear leg. Torso and head rise by 2% canvas over E01 while same scale. Lowest shoe stays about 5% of canvas ABOVE the fixed virtual floor y92%. Qin and both elbows rise with shoulders a little and angle forward, maintaining two distinct grips.
Both hands carry the rigid qin in front of chest: anatomical LEFT hand supports its upper/front end; anatomical RIGHT hand securely cradles the lower/near end. Both elbows and shoulders counter-rotate slightly toward the camera against the advanced left leg; keep exact grip contact, no hand swap, no detached fingers. Hair and sleeve ribbons flow gently behind to screen left. No plucking gesture, no effects or projectile.
Stable camera and body scale: virtual root center x=50%, virtual ground y=92% of full square (corresponding to export root x512 and ground942 at 1024). Keep full canvas composition, head top roughly 10% and landing sole y92%; no per-frame silhouette fitting. One independently painted pose with readable two feet and two hands. No shadow, ground drawing, text, border, scenery, duplicate pose, motion blur, extra limbs or cropping.
